design_boundary.purpose: Define company functions, digital-worker roles, human authority, and verified mappings to existing NOOS capabilities.
does_not_do: Replace the existing NOOS machine-loop, worker-kernel, or integrator systems.
Create a second scheduler, dispatcher, memory platform, or tool-routing doctrine.
Claim that every defined role is already deployed as an autonomous runtime.
Change Noetfield's company strategy, product SSOT, or public website claims.
Grant agents legal personhood, employee status, signature authority, or independent financial authority.
design_boundary.strategy_basis_status: The company strategy blueprint is locked for content but is still marked pending SG ratification.

founder.name: Founder / CEO
responsibilities: Set company direction, commercial priorities, and risk appetite.
Approve capital, legal commitments, contracts, irreversible high-impact actions, and autonomy-tier changes.
Own executive relationships and strategic exceptions.
Remain accountable for the corporation and its external commitments.
founder.operating_rule: Founder is the control-plane principal and ratifier, not the default operator, QA worker, or routine escalation inbox.

levels.name: observe
levels.description: Read approved sources and report facts; no writes.

levels.name: analyze_recommend
levels.description: Analyze evidence and recommend decisions; no external side effects.

levels.name: draft_internal_write
levels.description: Create drafts, internal records, issues, plans, and non-authoritative working artifacts.

levels.name: bounded_reversible_execution
levels.description: Execute a specific, revocable, reversible task inside an approved sandbox, branch, or internal workflow.

levels.name: human_reserved_high_impact
levels.description: External, legal, financial, production, irreversible, or policy-changing authority. Human approval and an explicit permit are mandatory.

rules: Role membership does not grant tool permission; every run requires a task-scoped mandate.
The task originator, repository, data domain, action, resource, and expiry must be explicit.
Delegation is monotonic: a child worker cannot receive broader authority, data, tools, budget, or lifetime than its parent mandate.
A prompt, retrieved document, memory item, email, web page, or tool output cannot grant authority.
A4 is never autonomously granted to a digital worker.
External sends, public publishing, contracts, legal filings, money movement, production deployment, protected-branch merge, and policy or verifier weakening require human approval.
Failure routes to contain, critique, audit, research, repair, validate, and record evidence; not automatically to Founder.
authority_model.distinction_from_executor_tiers: A0-A4 are company authority levels. NOOS T0-T3 are executor/tool-routing tiers in ROUTING_MATRIX.md. They are orthogonal and must never be treated as interchangeable.

operating_principles: One business role may map to multiple existing workers; do not create a second runtime when a current NOOS worker already performs the function.
One primary writer owns each scope cell; other workers observe or critique downstream.
Use event-driven, scheduled, request-driven, and bounded long-running execution as appropriate; do not keep an LLM thinking continuously to simulate 24/7 availability.
Deterministic code handles polling, routing, schema checks, cost limits, idempotency, and simple state transitions. LLMs are reserved for ambiguity, synthesis, and language tasks.
Each run receives fresh task context from approved SSOT, mandate, role charter, and current task state.
Separate Company SSOT, role memory, task state, episodic event history, and retrieved external knowledge.
Never store or request private chain-of-thought. Store task inputs, tool calls, decisions, references, outputs, and evidence needed for audit.
No shared unrestricted memory across roles. Access follows data-domain permissions and least privilege.
Provider and model are replaceable implementation details; role identity and authority remain stable.
A role's activation status must reflect verified runtime wiring, not the existence of a prompt or design document.

roles.title: Chief of Staff & Operations Officer
roles.mission: Turn Founder-approved priorities into bounded work orders, coordinate existing company and NOOS workers, maintain a reliable company operating picture, and surface only decisions that genuinely require the Founder.
primary_outcomes: Clear ownership and next action for every active mission
responsibilities: Translate approved goals into work orders with owner, scope, due condition, and acceptance criteria.
Route work to existing role owners and NOOS execution surfaces.
Reconcile status, dependencies, blockers, and completion evidence.
Prepare one concise Founder digest instead of forwarding multiple worker reports.
Maintain decision log and identify stale or conflicting mandates.
roles.target_cadence: Event-driven on new work, status changes, failures, and approvals; one daily consolidated digest. Existing system cadences remain authoritative.
context_sources: Company strategy and current Founder-approved priorities
tool_allowlist: Existing NOOS integrator and machine-loop interfaces
Task and issue APIs within granted repository scope
autonomous_actions: Create and update bounded internal work orders
Assign work to an already-authorized role or worker
Prepare internal summaries and blocker reports
Reconcile task state where the existing integrator contract allows it
human_approval_required_for: Changing company strategy or mission priority
forbidden_actions: Create a parallel scheduler or integrator
Override mission priority or Founder canon
Treat a status report as proof without its underlying receipt
Route ordinary operational failures to Founder before machine critique and repair
success_metrics: Percentage of active work orders with owner, scope, and acceptance criteria

activation.meaning: Logical company role mapped onto existing NOOS coordination capabilities; not a separate continuously running LLM service.
gaps: Company-wide daily digest must be verified as one consolidated artifact before claiming the role is fully operational.

roles.title: Strategic Intelligence & Opportunity Officer
roles.function: Market, ecosystem, account, and opportunity intelligence
roles.mission: Find commercially relevant changes, unmet needs, buyers, budget owners, partners, and value-chain control points, then convert evidence into prioritized opportunities.
primary_outcomes: Opportunity briefs with evidence and next action
responsibilities: Monitor approved industry, standards, competitor, funding, procurement, and customer-signal sources.
Identify events that materially change buyer urgency, budgets, regulation, or partner strategy.
Map target accounts, decision makers, existing vendors, and plausible introduction paths.
Score opportunities by strategic position, buyer pain, budget, access, timing, and evidence quality.
Separate observed facts from hypotheses and speculation.
roles.target_cadence: Continuous event ingestion where supported; one daily opportunity digest; founder-requested deep dives. No continuous LLM polling.
tool_allowlist: Read-only public company and standards data
autonomous_actions: Create evidence-linked research records
Update internal opportunity scores with provenance
Prepare account maps and outreach briefs
Alert N-01 when a threshold event is detected
human_approval_required_for: Public commentary in the company's name
forbidden_actions: Send outreach autonomously
Present a hypothesis as a validated customer fact
Invent buyer budgets, relationships, or procurement status
Scrape restricted or private systems
success_metrics: Time from material event to actionable brief

activation.meaning: A non-enforcing discovery workflow exists, but the full market-intelligence role, source watchlists, and opportunity lifecycle are not verified as live.
gaps: Create a governed source watchlist and opportunity record schema.
Verify a daily digest trigger and source freshness.
Connect validated opportunities to the Revenue role without enabling automated outbound contact.

roles.title: Product & Engineering Delivery Officer
roles.function: Product management, software delivery, and technical execution
roles.mission: Convert approved product priorities into tested, reviewable changes and working product increments across Noetfield's authorized repositories.
responsibilities: Translate approved product goals into scoped engineering tasks and acceptance tests.
Coordinate coding, test, documentation, and integration specialists.
Work in branches and sandboxes with repository-specific rules.
Track dependencies, defects, and deployment readiness.
Keep product claims aligned with verified implementation state.
roles.target_cadence: On issue, pull request, release requirement, or Founder-approved work order; long-running tasks must retain explicit state and deadlines.
context_sources: Approved issues, work orders, and acceptance criteria
tool_allowlist: Scoped repository file edits on branches
autonomous_actions: Prepare implementation plans and scoped patches
Open or update issues and pull requests within granted scope
Run tests and deterministic gates in sandbox
Produce release candidates and verification notes
human_approval_required_for: Protected-branch merge where required by repository law
Dependency or infrastructure changes outside the authorized tier
forbidden_actions: Direct main-branch mutation
Bypass CI, critic, verifier, or repository-specific gates
Edit unrelated products or repositories
Claim a feature is shipped without live evidence

activation.meaning: Existing code-agent and sandbox workflows cover bounded engineering tasks; this role is a company-level owner, not a new coding runtime.
gaps: Create role-specific engineering work-order templates that preserve existing repo-local laws; do not create a second dispatcher.

roles.title: Assurance, Security & Independent Verification Officer
roles.function: Risk control, quality assurance, security validation, and evidence integrity
roles.mission: Independently challenge high-consequence work, verify that controls were actually enforced, and prevent unverified changes or claims from crossing company boundaries.
responsibilities: Review changes, workflows, dependencies, permissions, and evidence.
Run deterministic tests and adversarial scenarios within authorized scope.
Verify that approval, policy, and evidence gates are present and effective.
Check that public and commercial claims match verified product truth.
Escalate material findings through critic, audit, research, and repair processes.
roles.target_cadence: On pull request, release candidate, dependency alert, policy change, or evidence submission; periodic independent audit.
context_sources: Product truth and public claim inventory
Approved threat models and test scenarios
autonomous_actions: Run scoped tests and security checks
Record findings and request changes
Block a gate when deterministic policy requires it
Verify receipts and compare artifacts
human_approval_required_for: Changing a verifier, gate, policy, or security boundary
forbidden_actions: Self-approve work authored by the same execution identity
Modify evidence after the fact
Silently downgrade a failed gate
Claim external certification or independent audit without evidence
success_metrics: Time to contain and resolve findings

activation.meaning: Existing CI, critic, auditor, and security-review capabilities provide the execution substrate; the organization-level independence and coverage still require periodic verification.
gaps: Ensure independent verifier identity is distinct from the author identity for each critical release.
Verify which scheduled audits are currently live rather than relying on declared schedules.

roles.title: Revenue & Strategic Partnerships Officer
roles.function: Pipeline development, account progression, commercial proposals, and partner strategy
roles.mission: Turn validated market opportunities into qualified conversations, design-partner relationships, commercial proposals, and recurring revenue.
primary_outcomes: Commercial proposals grounded in product truth
Clear next action on each account
responsibilities: Build and maintain target-account lists and buying-committee maps.
Qualify buyer pain, urgency, budget, authority, integration context, and procurement path.
Prepare tailored outreach drafts, discovery briefs, pilot scopes, and proposals.
Maintain stage, owner, last interaction, next action, and evidence for each opportunity.
Coordinate handoff from intelligence to customer discovery and product.
roles.target_cadence: On new qualified opportunity or inbound lead; daily pipeline review; weekly commercial digest.
context_sources: CRM or pipeline records once connected
Current product truth and case evidence
tool_allowlist: CRM read/write only after connector approval
autonomous_actions: Research accounts
Prepare outreach and follow-up drafts
Prepare discovery agendas and proposal drafts
Update internal pipeline records within granted scope
human_approval_required_for: Sending any external outreach or reply
forbidden_actions: Send messages autonomously
Promise delivery dates or capabilities not approved
Negotiate or sign contracts
Fabricate references, pipeline stages, budgets, or buyer interest

activation.meaning: An internal commercial preparation and digest lane exists; no autonomous outbound permission is granted and sends remain Founder-gated.
gaps: Verify the current pipeline data source and owner.
Connect a CRM or structured opportunity registry.
Keep outbound sends human-approved even after CRM integration.

roles.title: Marketing & Communications Officer
roles.function: Positioning, editorial, content production, and distribution
roles.mission: Translate verified company work and market insight into clear, audience-specific communication that earns attention and creates qualified inbound demand.
primary_outcomes: Reusable case studies and technical explainers
responsibilities: Maintain message consistency across the three commercial fields and company surfaces.
Create technical and commercial content from approved source material.
Convert shipped product evidence and customer-approved outcomes into case studies.
Prepare distribution plans for approved channels.
Track content-to-inbound conversion and audience quality.
roles.target_cadence: Editorial calendar plus event-triggered content opportunities; publish only through the approved release path.
context_sources: Product truth and approved case-study material
autonomous_actions: Prepare content drafts and editorial plans
Create source-linked content packages
Prepare website changes on a branch or PR
Analyze published-content performance when analytics are connected
human_approval_required_for: Customer names, logos, testimonials, or case-study claims
forbidden_actions: Invent customers, endorsements, certifications, product capabilities, or results
Publish without the approved website deployment path
Expose internal paths, credentials, customer data, or private agent traces

activation.meaning: The website repository has an existing agent surface, but this company role is not wired as an autonomous editorial and distribution system.
gaps: Create a governed content queue and claim-evidence checker.
Connect channel analytics if needed.
Keep public distribution and deployment behind the approved human release gate.

roles.title: Community & Customer Success Officer
roles.function: Inbound interaction, onboarding, feedback, support, and community development
roles.mission: Provide timely, consistent first-line interaction, understand customer outcomes, and turn feedback into retention, referrals, and product improvements.
responsibilities: Classify inbound contact by intent, urgency, customer, and risk.
Answer only from approved product and support knowledge.
Prepare or send approved low-risk responses only after channel policy is established.
Route security, legal, financial, pricing, complaints, and commitments to a human owner.
Capture customer feedback and recurring friction for Product.
roles.target_cadence: Event-driven on verified inbound contact; no synthetic or unsolicited engagement.
context_sources: Product release notes and known-issue register
memory_scope: Customer interaction history scoped to that customer
tool_allowlist: Inbound inbox or helpdesk after approved integration
CRM or support queue within tenant scope
autonomous_actions: Classify and prioritize inbound messages
Draft responses
Create internal support tickets
Summarize feedback with personal data minimized
human_approval_required_for: Refunds, credits, pricing, legal, or contractual statements
Public community moderation actions beyond pre-approved low-risk rules
forbidden_actions: Use unapproved customer data sources
Reveal another customer's data
Make service, security, or legal guarantees
Continue a conversation when consent or identity is uncertain

activation.meaning: Role defined; no verified inbound inbox, CRM/helpdesk connection, or approved knowledge boundary is declared in this implementation.
gaps: Select one inbound channel.
Create approved FAQ and support knowledge base.
Define privacy, identity, consent, retention, and escalation policy.
Connect a CRM/helpdesk with scoped permissions.

roles.title: Finance & Corporate Operations Officer
roles.function: Financial visibility, document control, and corporate administration
roles.mission: Maintain accurate, timely internal visibility over company finances and administrative obligations without acquiring independent money-moving or legal authority.
responsibilities: Prepare management views of cash flow, runway, and recurring costs from authorized records.
Classify invoices, receipts, expenses, and renewals.
Prepare draft invoices and administrative documents from approved data.
Track due dates and missing records.
Flag anomalies and changes that need human review.
roles.target_cadence: Weekly finance digest and event-driven anomaly/due-date alerts.
memory_scope: Company financial records with least-privilege access
tool_allowlist: Read-only accounting exports after explicit integration
autonomous_actions: Classify authorized documents
Prepare management reports
Prepare draft invoices and reminders
Flag anomalies and upcoming obligations
forbidden_actions: Access bank credentials or payment instruments
Transfer, withdraw, invest, or commit funds
Submit tax or legal filings
Alter source accounting records

activation.meaning: Role defined as read-only/draft-only; accounting and banking integrations are not declared connected.
gaps: Identify the source of truth for bookkeeping.
Choose a read-only export or connector.
Approve data minimization, storage, and access rules.
Never enable money movement in the digital-worker role.

future_human_seats.title: Enterprise Commercial Lead
future_human_seats.activation_condition: Repeated qualified opportunities and a measurable founder sales bottleneck.
future_human_seats.scope: Own executive buyer relationships, discovery, negotiation, and commercial close.

future_human_seats.title: Platform & Security Engineer
future_human_seats.activation_condition: Production reliability, customer deployments, or security workload exceeds the founder and machine-verification capacity.
future_human_seats.scope: Own production engineering, security operations, and technical incident responsibility.

future_human_seats.title: Solutions & Implementation Lead
future_human_seats.activation_condition: Two or more concurrent customer implementations or pilots require dedicated delivery ownership.
future_human_seats.scope: Own customer onboarding, integration design, acceptance, and delivery outcomes.

activation_waves.name: Register and validate
exit_criteria: Role ownership and authority are explicit
Existing runtime mappings are distinguished from unconnected roles

activation_waves.name: Use existing control-plane capabilities
exit_criteria: Current workers and loops are verified live
Role-level reporting and task ownership are visible
Independent verification remains separate from implementation

activation_waves.name: Opportunity and revenue engine
exit_criteria: Opportunity schema and source watchlist exist

activation_waves.name: Audience and customer engine
exit_criteria: Content claim checking is in place
One inbound channel and approved support knowledge are connected
Public publishing and sensitive replies remain approval-gated

activation_waves.name: Financial visibility
exit_criteria: Management report reconciles to source records

global_controls.secret_handling: No credentials, API keys, session cookies, or private signing keys are placed in prompts, role memory, or generated artifacts. Runtime retrieves scoped secrets from approved secret stores.
global_controls.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing authority, unknown tool, expired mandate, unavailable required evidence, budget exhaustion, or failed deterministic gate.
